intro: Klong Muang and Tubkaek are two linked beaches on the coast north of Ao Nang, about a 30–45 minute drive from Krabi town and the airport. The whole stretch is given over to mid-range and luxury resorts lined up along the sand, with limestone cliffs and the forested Khao Ngon Nak ridge behind them. Tubkaek, at the northern end, is the quieter beach with clear views out to the Hong Islands. The real draw here is calm and the sunset scenery, not convenience — there's almost no walkable street, few restaurants outside the hotels, and little nightlife. It works best for honeymooners, families who want an easy stay, and anyone happy to base their trip around the resort itself. The trade-off is that you have to plan transport, whether that's a private car, a hotel taxi or a self-drive rental.

blocks.html: Short answer: Klong Muang and Tubkaek form a quiet resort coast just north of Ao Nang — a line of upscale beachfront properties backed by limestone cliffs with views over the Hong Islands. It suits travellers who want a calm, low-key stay away from the crowds, but there are few shops or restaurants to walk to, so you'll need a car or taxi to reach Ao Nang or the town each time. Rates start around ฿3,500 and climb into the tens of thousands for the pool villas.

items.name: Amari Vogue Krabi
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Sea views · 5-star value · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star resort at the northern end of Tubkaek Beach, with rooms and villas in a northern-Thai style and many balconies facing the sea and the limestone islands. There's a beachfront pool, a spa and several restaurants. It rates consistently well on Tripadvisor, with guests praising the quiet setting and attentive staff. This is the most accessible 5-star starting price in the area — a good fit for couples and families who want sea views without paying villa rates.

items.name: Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Families · golf and a huge pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A large 276-room resort on Klong Muang Beach. Its calling cards are an enormous free-form pool, often cited as one of the biggest in Thailand, and a 9-hole golf course on site. There's a kids' club, an L'OCCITANE spa and several restaurants, and every room has a balcony or terrace. It suits families and golfers who want full facilities in one place. Worth knowing: parts of the resort are being refreshed during mid-2026, so check which areas are affected when you book.

items.name: Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Beachfront families · Thai-style service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star resort on Klong Muang Beach set in large tropical gardens, known for the warm Dusit Thani service and a long beachfront position. There are several pools, a kids' club, a spa and seaside restaurants, with a range of family-friendly rooms. Reviews praise the right-on-the-beach location, the leafy grounds and the breakfast buffet. A good fit for families and couples who want a beachfront resort with a Thai feel and room for children to play.

items.name: The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Quiet boutique · sunset views · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small 5-star boutique resort on Tubkaek Beach, set between the Hang Nak forest and the sea. Contemporary Thai-style rooms are spread through tropical gardens, with an outdoor pool that looks out to the islands, a beachfront restaurant and a garden spa. The selling point is a private, very quiet atmosphere and unusually good sunset views. Reviews single out the personal service, with staff remembering guests' names. Ideal for honeymooners and anyone who genuinely wants to get away from the crowds.

items.name: Nakamanda Resort & Spa
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Romantic villas · privacy · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star villa resort on Klong Muang Beach, blending Thai and modern architecture. Most units are villas and some have private pools, spread through quiet beachfront gardens. There's a pool by the sand, a spa and a sea-view restaurant. The draw is a romantic, very private feel without an international-brand price tag. Reviews praise the spacious villas, attentive staff and the calm location. A good fit for couples and honeymooners who want a beachfront villa with privacy.

items.name: Banyan Tree Krabi
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: All pool suites · honeymoon · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A luxury beachfront resort on Tubkaek Beach where all 72 units are suites and villas, each with its own private pool — many facing the Andaman Sea. It has a large Banyan Tree-brand spa, several restaurants and a high level of privacy. Best for honeymoons or special occasions where you want a private pool by the sea. Rates start in the tens of thousands, but for a luxury pool villa in this area it's a benchmark for service and seclusion.

items.name: Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Top luxury · private butler · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The most exclusive resort on Tubkaek Beach, with just 54 villas and pavilions in a Moorish-Thai style across expansive grounds — many with private infinity pools and walled gardens. The draw is 24-hour butler service, a high-end spa and several restaurants under the Ritz-Carlton Reserve banner. It's highly regarded for service and privacy and carries the area's top prices. For travellers marking a special occasion or wanting a top-tier experience without watching the budget.

faq.q: How is Klong Muang–Tubkaek different from Ao Nang?
faq.a: Ao Nang is the lively beach district, with a walkable strip of restaurants, bars and a pier for island trips, so you can get around on foot. Klong Muang and Tubkaek are about 15–20 minutes further north by car — a quiet resort coast with little outside the hotels. Their appeal is calm and luxury beachfront stays. Choose Klong Muang–Tubkaek for a peaceful, full-on relaxing trip; choose Ao Nang if you want to walk to food and drinks and reach boats easily.

faq.q: Can I stay here without a car?
faq.a: You can, but plan ahead. There's no real public transport and very few shops or restaurants outside the hotels, so most people rely on hotel shuttles or taxis, private cars, or ride-hailing apps. If you mainly intend to stay at the resort and head out to Ao Nang or island tours now and then, you'll be fine. But if you want to eat out every meal or see several places a day, a self-drive rental is more flexible and cheaper over a longer stay.

faq.q: What's the difference between Klong Muang and Tubkaek beaches?
faq.a: The two beaches sit side by side on the same coast but feel slightly different. Klong Muang is the longer beach with larger resorts like Sofitel and Dusit Thani, suiting families and those who want full facilities. Tubkaek, at the northern end, is quieter, with clear views of the Hong Islands, and is home to privacy-focused luxury resorts like Banyan Tree, Phulay Bay and The Tubkaak. Choose Klong Muang for families and activities; choose Tubkaek for the quietest setting and the best views.
